messages: Customer: Hi, can you tell me when my postpaid bill is due this month? My account number is 10458823.
Agent: Hello! The bill for account 10458823 is due on November 12. Is there anything else I can help with?
Customer: I tried to buy the 30GB monthly data bundle for 115 SAR, but my card was declined. I checked my bank app and nothing was deducted. Can I pay another way?
Customer: I ordered a new SIM for my postpaid line on Oct 22, order ORD-558201. Tracking said it would arrive Oct 27, but it still hasn't come.
Agent: Sorry about that. Order ORD-558201 is being held at the courier hub. I've escalated it.
Customer: Ok thanks, please let me know when it moves.
Customer: How do I add my daughter's number to my family plan? Is there a fee for each extra line?
Customer: recharged 50 sar last nite money gone frm my bank but balance still same?? txn 7731904562
Customer: hello?? any1
Customer: bought wrong bundle by mistake lol the 69 one, didnt use any of it. can u refund pls
Customer: cant log in app, otp never comes. tried like 10 times
Agent: Sorry to hear that. Can you confirm the mobile number linked to your account?
Customer: the usual one, nothing changed
Customer: wth is this, 3 charges of 25 each on my prepaid for some games service?? never signed up 4 anything
Agent: I'm sorry about this. I can see three charges of 25 SAR from a third-party content subscription, SUB-90412. Did anyone else use your phone?
Customer: no its only me. just want it gone and money back
Customer: yo net is dead at home, like nothing works. me, my wife, the kids, all on the family plan, no data no calls since fajr
Agent: I'm sorry. Can you share the family plan account number?
Customer: 20093317. pls fix fast
Customer: Good evening, hope you're well. I paid my postpaid bill, invoice INV-2026-0918, 347.50 SAR, through the app on Monday.
Agent: Good evening, and thank you for reaching out! How can I help you today?
Customer: Like I said, I paid invoice INV-2026-0918, and my bank shows 347.50 SAR taken twice. I only paid once.
Agent: Thanks for your patience. Lovely that the weather is finally cooling down, right? Let me check the payment records.
Customer: Yes finally haha. But please, the 347.50 SAR was taken twice and I need the extra one back.
Agent: Confirmed, two successful payments were received for INV-2026-0918. I've raised a refund for the duplicate.
Customer: Hi, I ordered the home 5G router with my family plan upgrade, order ORD-604117. Any update?
Agent: Hi! Thanks for choosing us. Let me check ORD-604117 for you.
Customer: Thanks. It was supposed to arrive last Thursday, and I've been waiting at home all week haha.
Agent: I understand. The courier marked it as delayed because of high volume. It should arrive within 3 business days.
Customer: They said 3 days last week too. Order ORD-604117, still nothing.
Agent: I'm sorry. I've escalated it to the logistics team, and you'll get an SMS once it's out for delivery.
Customer: Hello, how are you? Sorry, this is a bit strange. I got an SMS saying my SIM was replaced at a branch in Dammam. I haven't been to Dammam in years.
Agent: Good afternoon, I'm well, thank you. May I have your account number?
Customer: It's 30781266. Now my phone shows no signal, and I can't log into the app. It says the password was changed.
Agent: Thank you. Just a moment please, the system is a bit slow today.
Customer: No problem. But again: I got the SIM replacement SMS, I have no signal, and my password was changed. I didn't do any of this.
Agent: I understand. I've opened a case and blocked the new SIM while we verify your identity.

Customer: Two things. I forgot my web portal password, but I'm still logged in on the app so that's fine for now. The real issue is that I'm trying to renew my prepaid 20GB bundle for 85 SAR and the payment keeps getting declined. My bank says nothing went through.
Agent: Thanks for explaining. Could you try another card or Apple Pay?

Customer: My data stopped working yesterday from about 2pm to 9pm. It's working again now. But that was right after I bought the weekend data bundle for 39 SAR, and I couldn't use most of it. Can I get the 39 SAR back?
Agent: Sorry for the disruption. There was a regional issue yesterday that is now resolved. Let me check whether the bundle is eligible for a refund.
Customer: I ordered an extra SIM for my son on the family plan, order ORD-611290, and paid 30 SAR.
Customer: The app still says payment pending and the order hasn't been processed, but the 30 SAR has already left my account. Will the SIM still ship or what?
Customer: I topped up 180 SAR on my prepaid line on Tuesday. This morning the balance is 0, and I haven't made any calls. My data is switched off. Where did it go?
Agent: I'm sorry. I can see several deductions from the balance overnight. Did you subscribe to any services?
Customer: No. I don't recognise any of it.

Customer: My postpaid invoice this month has a new line: 45 SAR per month for an additional family member, subscription ID FM-77320. Only my wife and I are on the plan. I didn't add anyone, and I don't know whose number this is.
Agent: Thank you for flagging this. The member was added online on October 3. We'll look into it.

Customer: Since last night none of the phones in our house have had any signal. There are five of us on the same family plan, and every phone just says 'No service'. Our home internet bundle isn't working either.
Agent: I'm sorry. Could you give me the account number for the family plan?
Customer: Sure, 40556192.
Customer: السلام عليكم. I cancelled the international calls add-on for 150 SAR the same day I subscribed and never used it. ممكن ترجعون المبلغ؟
Agent: وعليكم السلام. I can see the cancellation. I'll submit a refund request for you.
Customer: مرحبا، my postpaid invoice INV-2026-1044 shows 230 SAR, but my plan is 200. وش هذا الفرق؟
Agent: Hello! The difference is the 15% VAT applied to your plan charge.
Customer: Hi, my home internet invoice INV-2026-55812 is 345.00 SAR but my plan is only 299 SAR. What is the extra amount for?
Agent: Hello, thanks for reaching out. Let me open that invoice and check the line items for you.
Customer: I can't sign in to the wallet app. The OTP code never arrives on my phone. I've tried three times today.
Agent: Sorry about that. Can you confirm the mobile number linked to your wallet?
Customer: I ordered a Galaxy S25 on the 24-month installment plan, order ORD-778214. Tracking said delivery on Monday and it's Thursday now with no update.
Agent: Apologies for the delay. I'll check with the courier on order ORD-778214 right away.
Customer: If I take an iPhone on installments, can I pay off the remaining amount early without any penalty?
Customer: tried paying my bill in app like 5 times, keeps saying declined. card is fine tho, bank shows nothing taken. amt 199
Customer: hey cancelled the router order 55120 b4 it shipped, paid 450 where my money
Agent: Hi! Let me look into order 55120 for you.
Customer: ok pls fast
Customer: net super slow every nite after 9, cant even load yt. mornings ok tho
Customer: put wrong pin 3x now app locked me out lol help
Agent: No problem, I can help you reset it. Is the app showing a timer or a message to contact support?
Customer: says contact support
Customer: sim delivery was supposed 2 come yesterday. courier never showed n not answering. ref DLV-30917
Customer: Hi, good evening, hope you're doing well.
Agent: Good evening! Doing well, thank you. How can I help you today?
Customer: So my installment statement for account 4410293 shows two lines, one for the phone and one for 'device protection'. I don't remember what the second one is for.
Agent: Sure, one moment while I pull up account 4410293.
Customer: No rush. Sorry, my kids are being loud in the background.
Customer: I just want to understand the device protection line, I'm not disputing it, just curious what it covers.
Customer: Hello, I topped up my wallet with 500 SAR from my bank card about two hours ago.
Agent: Hello, thanks for contacting us. What seems to be the problem with the top-up?
Customer: The bank already took the 500 SAR but my wallet balance is still the same as before.
Agent: I understand. Could you share the reference shown on the top-up screen?
Customer: It's TPU-8823341. The bank took the money, the wallet still shows the old balance.
Customer: Hello? Are you still there? The 500 SAR is gone from my bank and it's not in the wallet.
Customer: Hi there, I'm waiting on the new fiber router, order ORD-660129.
Agent: Hi! Thanks for your patience. Let me check that for you.
Customer: Thanks. By the way, the technician who came last month was really nice, please pass that on.
Agent: That's kind of you, I'll share it with the team. Order ORD-660129 shows it left the warehouse on the 20th.
Customer: Yes, but it's been stuck at 'out for delivery' since the 22nd.
Customer: Still stuck at 'out for delivery'. Can someone please check where the router actually is?

Customer: Two things. My autopay for the phone bill was declined last week, the bank says nothing was charged so I'll just pay it manually. The bigger problem is I can't open the app at all since the update, it keeps sending me back to the login screen after I enter my password.
Customer: I wanted to ask if I'm eligible to add a second device on installments, but first, my tablet from order ORD-551870 still hasn't arrived and it's been 10 days.
Agent: I can help with both. Let me check order ORD-551870 first.

Customer: The home internet keeps cutting out for a few minutes every hour, then it comes back on its own. I'm paying for the top plan, so I think I deserve some kind of discount. Can you fix the line or adjust my bill?
Customer: There's a payment of 1,250 SAR from my wallet to 'ALNOOR TRADING' this morning. I've never bought anything from them and I was asleep at that time. Transaction number TRX-40917722.
Agent: Thank you for letting us know. Has anyone else had access to your phone or wallet PIN?
Customer: No, nobody. I just want to know where my money went.
Customer: My monthly installment for the phone, 187.50 SAR, was taken twice from my card on the 1st. Same amount, same time. Installment account INS-209384. Please send the second one back.
Customer: Since last night nothing in the house connects. No internet on any phone, the TV or the laptop. The light on the box is red.
Agent: I'm sorry to hear that. Have you tried restarting the router?
Customer: Three times. Still red. My kids have online classes tomorrow and my husband works from home. Account 7720158.
Customer: My phone suddenly says 'no service' since this afternoon, and I got an email saying my wallet was signed in on a new device. I didn't get a new phone or SIM.
Agent: I understand. Did you request a SIM replacement recently?
Customer: No. And now I can't log into the wallet either, it says the password was changed.
Customer: I sent 800 to my brother from the wallet yesterday at 6 pm. It left my balance right away but he still hasn't received anything. Reference WT-5571209.
Agent: Thanks, I'll trace WT-5571209 for you.
Customer: Please, he needs it for rent.
